summary: Change Log Hub notes are authored as repo JSON on each user-facing PR and synced into the public hub automatically on deploy.
detailed_changes: Added changelog/releases/*.json as the source of truth for published hub releases.
Added php artisan newsroom:sync-releases and run it from Cloudron activate after migrate.
Added a CI gate that requires a changelog entry (or skip-changelog) before merge.
affected_areas: Page or route: /change-log-hub, deploy activate, CI
User groups affected: public visitors reading the hub; contributors shipping PRs
Public impact: hub updates on each deploy that includes new changelog JSON
Internal impact: PR authors add a structured entry instead of Admin CRUD for routine releases
